concepts.name: Admin Dashboard SPA
concepts.summary: A Vite-built React single-page application that is the administration surface of the ORISO counselling platform. `src/index.tsx` boots it, `src/App.tsx` and `src/AdminApp.tsx` wire routing, providers and the lazy page registry in `src/pages/lazyPages.ts`, and `src/components/Layout` supplies the protected and public page shells. The container ships as static assets served by nginx (`Dockerfile`) alongside a small auth backend-for-frontend in `scripts/`.

concepts.name: API Layer
concepts.summary: Every backend call goes through `src/api/fetchData.ts`, which centralises URL building, auth headers, CSRF and error shaping (`FetchErrorWithOptions`). Below it, `src/api/` is split one folder per backend concern — tenant, agency, counselor, admins, topic, invitelinks, accountInvites, legal, settings, statistic, tutorial, user, consultingtype, idAllocation, passwordReset — and `src/appConfig.ts` resolves the endpoint bases the folders use.

concepts.name: Management Domains (Pages)
concepts.summary: `src/pages/` is organised by administrative domain: Tenants, Agency, users, Topics, Links (invites), Statistic, Logs, GlobalSettings, TenantSettings, Profile, plus the public surfaces Login, PasswordReset, TenantOnboarding and CounsellorOnboarding. Each domain typically has a `List` and an `Edit` route, and the sidebar entries live in `src/components/Layout/adminNavItems.ts`.

concepts.name: Tenant Administration
concepts.summary: Tenants (Träger) are the top-level configurable unit. `src/pages/Tenants` lists and edits them, while the heavy configuration lives in `src/components/Tenants` — GeneralSettings (name, logo, colours, ThemeBuilder), AppSettings (communication, notifications, topics, permissions, SMTP, Erstantwort texts), LegalSettings and DpiaSettings. Reads and writes run through `src/api/tenant/` and the `useTenantData` / `useTenantDataMutation` hooks.

concepts.name: Agency and Department Administration
concepts.summary: Agencies (Beratungsstellen) are edited in `src/pages/Agency/Edit`, split into GeneralInformation, AgencySettings, ContactSettings, RegistrationSettings (including PostCodeRanges), ResponsibleSettings and DepartmentDetails. `src/api/agency/` covers create, update, delete, type change, post-code ranges, consultant assignment and department-level data protection/imprint documents; `src/pages/Agency/List/agencySort.ts` holds the list ordering rules.

concepts.name: User, Consultant and Admin Administration
concepts.summary: `src/pages/users` manages consultants, agency admins, tenant admins and platform admins in one table (`management/UserManagementTable.tsx`, `useUserTableColumns.tsx`, `userTableConfigs.ts`) with section pills to switch cohorts. Creation and edit go through `src/api/counselor/` and `src/api/admins/`, including granting a consultant identity to an admin (`grantConsultantIdentityData.ts`, gated by `src/utils/canGrantConsultantIdentity.ts`).

concepts.name: Account Invites and Invite Links
concepts.summary: The Links page bundles two mechanisms: per-person account invites (`src/api/accountInvites/accountInvites.ts` — list, create, send, resend, revoke plus email-template CRUD and preview) and topic-scoped registration links (`src/api/invitelinks/topicInviteLinks.ts`). The UI adds an InviteComposer, a CSV bulk import (`src/pages/Links/csv/parseInviteCsv.ts`) and a progress board whose phase model lives in `src/pages/Links/inviteProgress/derivePhases.ts`.

concepts.name: Legal Texts and Consent Editing
concepts.summary: `src/components/Tenants/LegalSettings` is the editor for tenant and agency legal texts: draft handling (`hooks/useLegalDraft.ts`, `utils/legalDraftStorage.ts`), version selection (`utils/legalVersionOptions.ts`, `src/api/legal/getLegalTextVersions.ts`), consent templates and their validation (`utils/consentTextValidation.ts`), plus publish-time modals for source warnings and translate-on-publish. Machine translation of legal content goes through `src/api/tenant/translation.ts`.

concepts.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and its Gate
concepts.summary: A tenant's DPA has its own status, versions and signature endpoints in `src/api/tenant/` (`getDpaStatus`, `getDpaVersions`, `getDpaSignatures`, `signDpaAdmin`, `publishDpa`, `createDpaSignInvite`, `sendDpaInviteEmail`). Until it is signed, `src/components/DpaBlocker/DpaBlockerGate.tsx` blocks the admin UI, driven by `src/api/tenant/getDpaGate.ts` and `src/utils/dpaBlockerGate.ts`. `src/components/DpaForwardDialog` lets an admin forward the signing task to a legally authorised person.

concepts.name: DPIA Master Data and Text Editor
concepts.summary: The data protection impact assessment is edited per tenant under `src/components/Tenants/DpiaSettings`: a section selector, a rich-text editor container and defaults in `utils/dpiaDefaults.ts` / `utils/dpiaSections.ts`, talking to the backend via `api/dpiaTextGateway.ts` and `src/api/tenant/getDpiaMasterData.ts` / `updateDpiaMasterData.ts`. `src/components/Dpia/DpiaDocumentPage.tsx` renders the resulting document.

concepts.name: Roles, Permissions and Access Gates
concepts.summary: Keycloak roles from the token are mapped to UI permissions in `src/constants/userRolesToPermissions.ts`, which merges role permissions and applies a ceiling for restricted agency admins; `src/hooks/useUserPermission.ts` and `src/utils/adminPortalAccess.ts` gate routes and controls. Tenant-wide permission policies are configured in `src/components/Tenants/AppSettings/PermissionsSettings` and persisted via `src/api/tenant/tenantPermissionPolicies.ts`.

concepts.name: Authentication Session and Auth BFF
concepts.summary: Login and token lifetime are handled in `src/api/auth/auth.ts` (bootstrap, refresh timers, token accessors) with storage split between httpOnly cookies (`accessSessionCookie.ts`), local storage (`accessSessionLocalStorage.ts`) and an in-memory store (`tokenSessionStore.ts`). A small Node backend-for-frontend in `scripts/auth-bff-handlers.mjs` (served by `scripts/auth-bff-server.mjs`, proxied in dev by `vite.authBffPlugin.ts`) sets, clears and refreshes those cookies against Keycloak.

concepts.name: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
concepts.summary: `src/components/TwoFactorSetup` implements both app-based (TOTP) and email-based second factors, with a shared state machine in `twoFactorSetupFlow.ts` and separate entry points for onboarding and the profile page. `src/api/user/apiTwoFactorAuth.ts` performs the calls; `src/utils/platformAdminTwoFactorGate.ts` and `src/hooks/useTwoFactorSetupDeferral.hook.ts` decide when setup is mandatory or may be deferred.

concepts.name: Statistics Dashboard and Audit Logs
concepts.summary: `src/pages/Statistic.tsx` renders the dashboard; the shaping of periods, topics, targets and chart series is pure logic in `src/pages/Statistic/statisticDashboardData.ts`, fed by `src/api/statistic/getDashboardStatistics.ts` and a tutorial-progress section. Separately, `src/pages/Logs` shows case-handover, supervisor and inactive-account audit logs through dedicated hooks.

concepts.name: Design System and MUI Migration
concepts.summary: The repo is moving from AntD to MUI: `src/components/mui/` holds the replacement form fields (MuiFormField, MuiSelectField, MuiSwitchField, MuiColorField, MuiSliderField) and `docs/admin-mui9-antd-inventory.md` tracks what is left. Theming is generated from M3 seeds in `src/utils/themeSeeds.ts` and `src/utils/theme/orisoScheme.ts` and applied via `src/hooks/useAdminTheme.hook.ts`; a card system, DataTable and the mobile navigation complete the shared UI kit.

flows.name: Admin Logs In → Reaches the Management Shell
flows.summary: `src/pages/Login/LoginForm.tsx` submits credentials through `src/hooks/useLoginMutation.hook.ts` → tokens are exchanged and stored by `src/api/auth/auth.ts` with cookie help from `scripts/auth-bff-handlers.mjs` → `src/components/Layout/Initialization.tsx` bootstraps user, tenant and feature data → `src/constants/userRolesToPermissions.ts` turns Keycloak roles into UI permissions → `src/components/Layout/ProtectedPageLayoutWrapper.tsx` renders the sidebar from `adminNavItems.ts`.

flows.name: Platform Admin Creates and Configures a Tenant
flows.summary: `src/pages/Tenants/List/index.tsx` starts creation → `src/hooks/useAddOrUpdateTenant.hook.ts` posts via `src/api/tenant/addTenantData.ts` → the editor `src/pages/Tenants/Edit/index.tsx` opens the General, AppSettings, LegalSettings and ThemeSettings tabs → branding is edited in `src/components/Tenants/GeneralSettings/index.tsx` with logo upload through `src/api/tenant/uploadTenantMedia.ts` → changes are persisted with `src/hooks/useTenantDataMutation.hook.ts`.

flows.name: Admin Creates an Agency → Assigns Topics and Consultants
flows.summary: `src/pages/Agency/List/index.tsx` opens the create route → `src/pages/Agency/Edit/index.tsx` collects general, registration and contact data → topic ids are normalised by `src/api/agency/normalizeTopicIds.ts` before `src/api/agency/addAgencyData.ts` is called → post-code ranges are stored via `src/api/agency/updateAgencyPostCodeRange.ts` → consultants are attached with `src/api/agency/assignAgencyToConsultants.ts`.

flows.name: Admin Invites an Account → Tracks it to Acceptance
flows.summary: `src/pages/Links/InviteComposer.tsx` (or the bulk path `src/pages/Links/InviteCsvImportModal.tsx` with `csv/parseInviteCsv.ts`) creates invites through `src/api/accountInvites/accountInvites.ts` → the mail body comes from an invite email template previewed by `src/hooks/useInviteEmailPreview.hook.ts` → sent invites appear in `src/pages/Links/AccountInvitesTab.tsx` → `src/pages/Links/inviteProgress/derivePhases.ts` derives phase and bucket for `InviteProgressBoard.tsx`, where invites can be resent or revoked.

flows.name: Invited Tenant Admin Onboards via Link
flows.summary: The invite link opens `src/pages/TenantOnboarding/TenantAdminOnboardingPage.tsx` → `useTenantAdminOnboardingFlow.ts` drives the steps against the client in `src/api/tenantOnboarding/tenantOnboarding.ts`, which raises `InviteLinkError` for dead or used links (rendered by `LinkErrorState.tsx`) → AccountStep sets credentials, TwoFactorStep runs the second factor, OrganisationDpaStep presents the DPA → DoneStep closes the flow.

flows.name: Tenant Admin Passes the DPA Gate → Signs or Forwards
flows.summary: `src/components/DpaBlocker/DpaBlockerGate.tsx` asks `src/hooks/useDpaGate.hook.ts` (backed by `src/api/tenant/getDpaGate.ts`) whether the admin area is blocked → `src/utils/dpaBlockerGate.ts` decides the blocking state → the admin either signs with `src/api/tenant/signDpaAdmin.ts` or opens `src/components/DpaForwardDialog/DpaForwardDialog.tsx` → `src/api/tenantOnboarding/dpaForward.ts` creates the forward link, enforces the forward budget and reports awaiting-signature state.

flows.name: Admin Edits a Legal Text → Translates → Publishes
flows.summary: `src/components/Tenants/LegalSettings/index.tsx` loads the current text and its versions via `src/hooks/useLegalTextVersions.hook.ts` → editing happens in the Tiptap-based editor `src/components/FormPluginEditor/TiptapEditor.tsx` with drafts kept by `hooks/useLegalDraft.ts` → consent placeholders are checked by `utils/consentTextValidation.ts` → publishing shows `TranslateOnPublishModal` which calls `src/api/tenant/translation.ts` for the remaining locales.

flows.name: Admin Edits DPIA Master Data
flows.summary: The DPIA tab loads master data with `src/hooks/useDpiaMasterData.hook.ts` from `src/api/tenant/getDpiaMasterData.ts` → `src/components/Tenants/DpiaSettings/components/DpiaSectionSelect/index.tsx` picks a section defined in `utils/dpiaSections.ts` → the section text is edited in `DpiaTextEditorContainer` and written back through `src/hooks/useDpiaMasterDataMutation.hook.ts` → `src/components/Dpia/DpiaDocumentPage.tsx` renders the assembled document.

flows.name: Admin Configures Tenant Permission Policies
flows.summary: `src/components/Tenants/AppSettings/PermissionsSettings/index.tsx` picks the variant for the current role (SuperAdmin, Tenant or Agency permissions) → toggles are resolved by `permissionsToggleLogic.ts` and `permissionsSettingsUtils.ts`, with case-handover specifics in `CaseHandoverCard` and `src/constants/caseHandoverAccess.ts` → the resulting policy is saved via `src/api/tenant/tenantPermissionPolicies.ts` and read back by `src/hooks/useTenantPermissionPolicies.ts`.

flows.name: Admin Opens the Statistics Dashboard
flows.summary: `src/pages/Statistic.tsx` reads stored filter preferences from `src/pages/Statistic/statisticPreferences.ts` → `useStatisticDashboardData.hook.ts` fetches raw numbers via `src/api/statistic/getDashboardStatistics.ts` → `statisticDashboardData.ts` builds week starts, topic and target series and empty states → charts render through `statisticChartUtils.ts`, and `TutorialStatisticsSection.tsx` adds tutorial progress from `src/api/statistic/getTutorialStatistics.ts`.

layerDescriptions.Domain Concepts: Orientation catalogue for the admin shell and API layer, tenant and agency administration, invitations, legal texts, DPA, DPIA, permissions, authentication and 2FA, statistics, design components, and their administrative flows.
layerDescriptions.API Layer: Everything under `src/api/` plus the auth backend-for-frontend in `scripts/` — typed client functions per backend concern (tenant, agency, counselor, admins, topic, invites, legal, settings, statistic, user) funnelled through `src/api/fetchData.ts`.
layerDescriptions.External Services: The nginx base image declared in the `Dockerfile` that serves the built admin bundle and the auth-BFF scripts.
layerDescriptions.UI Layer: React pages under `src/pages/` and components under `src/components/` — tenant/agency/user editors, DataTable, cards, MUI form fields, DPA and DPIA dialogs, the rich-text editors and their Storybook stories.
layerDescriptions.Core: Application wiring and domain glue: `src/App.tsx`, `src/AdminApp.tsx`, `src/appConfig.ts`, `src/i18n.ts`, the data-fetching hooks in `src/hooks/`, contexts, enums and types.
layerDescriptions.Utility Layer: Pure helpers in `src/utils/` — theming and branding, JWT and HAL parsing, validation, error-message extraction, permission and gate predicates, plus Storybook decorators.
layerDescriptions.Configuration Layer: Build- and runtime-configuration files such as the Vite config and the `.env.example` variables (Keycloak URL/realm/client, API and app URLs, cookie domain and security flags).
layerDescriptions.Test Layer: The Vitest setup in `src/test/` (`setup.ts`, `memoryStorage.ts`, AntD notice cleanup) that supports the unit and component tests colocated with the source.
